answer: An identity bond decays 8 credits each epoch unless its owner files a fresh dawn report on one tundra plot's nectar yield. Auditors recompute it from the public bloom table; a missed dawn, copied yield, or shared plot burns the bond. The k-th filing costs 34+8(k-1), so 1,000 fakes spend 4,030,000 with 70,000 locked, for a 40,000 pool. Rented yields fail: each plot yields once per dawn. Honest agents file once, pay 34, and get the bond back.
